record.name: The Beacon (day resource center)
record.administeredBy: Catholic Charities Diocese of Madison, in a public-private partnership with Dane County and the City of Madison
record._categoriesNote: A daytime homeless services center -- meals, showers, laundry, mail, plus housing and employment navigation. Straddles food-basic-needs and housing-utilities.
record.summary: A daytime drop-in center for people experiencing homelessness in Dane County. Guests find meals, showers, laundry, a safe place during the day, and on-site connections to housing, employment, health, and benefits help.
record.benefit: Daytime shelter and basic-needs services, plus co-located partner agencies (Porchlight, Housing Navigation, Catalyst for Change, JustDane, and others) for housing, case management, and crisis support.

steps: Walk in during open hours -- The Beacon is open 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, 365 days a year, at 615 E. Washington Ave., Madison.
No application, referral, or appointment is described.
Ask front-desk / guest services staff to connect you with a partner agency for housing or benefits.

of._sourceText: a daytime drop-in shelter and resource center for individuals and families experiencing homelessness in Dane County

eligibility._note: That is the entire published rule: experiencing homelessness + in Dane County. No income figure, no documentation, no application. Walk-in during open hours.

factsNeeded.sourceText: individuals and families experiencing homelessness -- housingStatus has 'unhoused-or-temporary' which is close, but 'experiencing homelessness' in the McKinney-Vento sense is broader (doubled-up, motels, imminent loss)

unencodable: Nothing material is left unencodable -- the rule is genuinely just 'homeless + Dane County'. The complexity is in the partner agencies' own programs, each with separate (mostly unpublished-here) criteria.

hops: the-beacon/ -> the-beacon/about-us/ -- 'What We Do' describes the center and its purpose; the only eligibility framing is 'people experiencing homelessness in Dane County'
access.format: none published (beyond 'experiencing homelessness in Dane County')

scopeColocated.scopeLocation: No figures. The one condition ('experiencing homelessness in Dane County') is stated plainly and repeatedly. n/a.

cost.notes: 3 fetch attempts (1 wrong org) + 2 searches. The name collision ('beaconhelps.org' vs the Madison Beacon) cost the extra round-trip.

surprises: A jointly city+county+diocese-run facility with a rule so simple ('homeless, Dane County') it barely needs the interview -- and a name that collides with an unrelated charity on a near-identical domain. Disambiguating the ENTITY was harder than capturing the rule.
